title: anchusa undulata subsp. granatensis
intro: Anchusa undulata subsp. granatensis, commonly known as alpiste or alpiste blanco, is a plant species belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is a flowering plant used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of alpiste blanco include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory problems. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
